raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #43175.

`executors/base.py` and `core/generator.py` caught any `ImportError` from the SGLang runtime imports, printed "sglang.multimodal_gen is not installed", and continued with `SamplingParams` / `prepare_request` / `DiffGenerator` undefined. When sglang is installed but a dependency is missing, that message is wrong, the real missing module is never shown, and the user later gets a `NameError` on the first DiT step or model load.

## Modifications

- Both modules now report the real `ImportError` (so the missing module is named) and keep importing, so ComfyUI still loads the nodes and shows the error. Re-raising here would make the plugin's `__init__.py` turn it into empty node mappings without a word.
- The error is stored and re-raised as `RuntimeError("SGLang diffusion runtime failed to import")` chained to the original at first use: `SGLDiffusionExecutor._execute_packed` and `SGLDiffusionGenerator.init_generator`.
- Tests load private copies of both modules with the runtime import blocked (`mock.patch.dict(sys.modules, ...)`, nothing leaks into other tests) and check the message and the chained error.

## Accuracy Tests

No model code changes. Repro with sglang from main and `imageio_ffmpeg` missing:

```
real cause:  ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'imageio_ffmpeg'   <- ...entrypoints.utils import prepare_request
before:      Error: sglang.multimodal_gen is not installed. Please install it using 'pip install sglang[diffusion]'
after:       Error: failed to import the SGLang diffusion runtime: ModuleNotFoundError("No module named 'imageio_ffmpeg'"). Install the diffusion extras with 'pip install sglang[diffusion]'.
```

Unit tests (CPU):

```
before fix: 2 failed, 5 passed   test_comfyui_generator.py   (misleading message; NameError: name 'DiffGenerator' is not defined)
after fix:  90 passed, 11 skipped (CUDA only), 3 xfailed   test_comfyui_{session,adapters,h3,generator,profile}.py, test_conditioning_cache.py
            12 passed   apps/ComfyUI_SGLDiffusion/test/test_h3_request.py
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

None; one `is not None` check per DiT call and per model load.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (not needed)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (not applicable)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -83,3 +83,55 @@ def terminate():
     runtime.kill_generator()
     assert owned.terminated is True
     assert owned.killed is False
+
+
+def _load_with_blocked_import(relpath, module_name, blocked):
+    """Import a private copy of a plugin module while ``blocked`` fails to import."""
+    import importlib.util
+    import sys
+    from pathlib import Path
+    from unittest import mock
+
+    import sglang.multimodal_gen.apps.ComfyUI_SGLDiffusion as plugin
+
+    path = Path(plugin.__file__).parent / relpath
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(module_name, path)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    with mock.patch.dict(sys.modules, {blocked: None}):  # None makes import raise
+        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def test_executor_reports_real_runtime_import_error(capsys) -> None:
+    import pytest
+    import torch
+
+    blocked = "sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.entrypoints.utils"
+    base = _load_with_blocked_import("executors/base.py", "_sgld_base_blocked", blocked)
+    printed = capsys.readouterr().out
+    assert blocked in printed
+    assert "is not installed" not in printed
+
+    class _Executor(base.SGLDiffusionExecutor):
+        def __init__(self):
+            torch.nn.Module.__init__(self)
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="failed to import") as err:
+        _Executor()._execute_packed(None, None, None)
+    assert isinstance(err.value.__cause__, ImportError)
+    assert blocked in str(err.value.__cause__)
+
+
+def test_generator_reports_real_runtime_import_error(caplog) -> None:
+    import pytest
+
+    blocked = "sglang.multimodal_gen"
+    module = _load_with_blocked_import(
+        "core/generator.py",
+        "sglang.multimodal_gen.apps.ComfyUI_SGLDiffusion.core._generator_blocked",
+        blocked,
+    )
+    assert any(blocked in record.getMessage() for record in caplog.records)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="failed to import") as err:
+        module.SGLDiffusionGenerator().init_generator("flux", "FluxPipeline", {})
+    assert isinstance(err.value.__cause__, ImportError)
